description: Defines the ApiError class used for standardized API error responses, including fields like code, message, details, timestamp, and path.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: A POJO class representing a standardized structure for API error responses, including serialization annotations.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the error.

methods.name: setTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the error.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the request path where the error occurred.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the request path where the error occurred.
